activity_context.topic_title: Finding Intercepts and Intersections of Hyperbolas

examples.knowledge_point: Finding the X-Intercepts of a Hyperbola
examples.worked_solution:
To find the $x$-intercepts of the hyperbola, we substitute $y=0$ into the equation of the hyperbola and solve for $x,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{(x+1)^{2}}{10}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{25} & =1 \\ \frac{(x+1)^{2}}{10}-\frac{{0}^{2}}{25} & =1 \\ \frac{(x+1)^{2}}{10} & =1 \\ (x+1)^{2} & =10 \\ x+1 & =\pm \sqrt{10} \\ x & =-1\pm \sqrt{10}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the $x$-intercepts are $\left(-1\pm \sqrt{10},0\right).$
